name: C. L. Brinker
role: Northern Pacific station agent at Medora, 1884
bio: C. L. Brinker arrived in May 1884 as the Northern Pacific's new station agent at Medora, replacing Mr. Spurrier, and his name ran on the Northern Pacific time table printed in the paper into December 1884. The paper noted his father's illness in June and joked in August that the depot roof leaked on him in the rain. In October 1884 he took a month's leave to visit his home in Pennsylvania, with J. R. Fegan acting as agent.
